summary: Blends, sequences, or constrains attached 3D object transforms from multiple parent inputs, enabling animated parenting, partial transform inheritance, and three-parent orientation setups.

key_params.name: parenttype
key_params.note: Blend, Sequence, or Constrain parent transform mode

key_params.name: sequence
key_params.note: Selects which input parent contributes in Sequence or Constrain modes

key_params.name: reset
key_params.note: Frame where constrain mode resets to the original transform

key_params.name: blendm1
key_params.note: Transform components inherited from input parent 1

key_params.name: blendm2
key_params.note: Transform components inherited from input parent 2

key_params.name: blendm3
key_params.note: Transform components inherited from input parent 3

key_params.name: blendm4
key_params.note: Transform components inherited from input parent 4

key_params.name: noffset
key_params.note: Offset normal to the plane formed by exactly three parents

key_params.name: axesorient
key_params.note: Orient local axes from exactly three parent inputs

key_params.name: shortrot
key_params.note: Use quaternion short rotation when blending two inputs

key_concepts: Blend COMP combines attached 3D object parent transforms for animated parenting and partial transform inheritance.
It affects the object transform only, not the internal contents of the blended components.
Blend mode combines up to the first four input parents using weights and transform masks.
Sequence and Constrain modes switch or constrain the child to a selected input parent while preserving the appropriate transform behavior.
Normal offset, axis orientation, and short-rotation options handle three-parent orientation and quaternion blending cases.
common_gotchas: Blend COMP affects object transforms only, not the contents of blended components.
The visual effect is visible through a Camera COMP or Render TOP rendering the camera view.
Blend mode only blends up to the first four inputs using the corresponding weights and masks.
A Sequence value outside the input range is interpreted as unparenting the child.
Constrain mode preserves relative transform when the constrained parent changes, with Reset Frame controlling reset behavior.
build_relevance: 2021.10000+ object transform blending and animated parenting
